claim: Trace Press makes free printable Dolch sight word flash cards in the browser: the 40 pre-primer words come out as 10 US Letter sheets of four 3 x 5 inch cards with dashed lines to cut along, and one tick adds a dotted copy of each word on writing lines to trace. No sign-up.
notes: Real-time capture of the live site at 360x640 CSS px, 3x device pixels. The grey ring marks each tap. It pages through the first sheets of cards, ticks the copy to trace, downloads the PDF, and ends on sheets 1 (a, and, away, big) and 10 (we, where, yellow, you) of that PDF rendered from the file. The final 2.2 s hold sheet 10 still for the end card.
